_note: Editorial ordinal guides, not official measurements. friction 1-4 = relative amount of local eligibility checking or variation; pool 1-4 = relative resale depth/speed. See the text beside the table for interpretation and limits.

shanghai.friction_note: No citywide extra qualification rule is evident in the material reviewed; confirm your exact documents and district process with the housing bureau.
shanghai.pool_note: Compare recent registered sales and days on market for the same building and unit type; city averages conceal price-band differences.

beijing.friction_note: Ask whether the spouse's property holdings or status enter your eligibility review; do not treat a verbal answer as approval.
beijing.pool_note: Check recent registered sales for this building and verify any school-catchment claim directly with the district education authority.

shenzhen.friction_note: Confirm which local social-insurance or tax records the bureau accepts and whether any district-specific documents apply.
shenzhen.pool_note: Liquidity varies sharply by subdistrict and building age; compare registered transactions and time-on-market for the exact stock type.

guangzhou.friction_note: Ask the district housing bureau to confirm the current rule for your household and this exact unit; do not rely on citywide summaries.
guangzhou.pool_note: Compare registered transactions for the exact district and building; peripheral stock and informal rental claims need separate verification.

hangzhou.friction_note: If eligibility depends on contribution history, obtain a written statement of the period and records required for your case.
hangzhou.pool_note: Compare completed registered sales, not launch prices, in the exact peripheral district and building phase.

suzhou.friction_note: Confirm the address-specific housing, registration and renovation process with the relevant district office before paying a deposit.
suzhou.pool_note: Do not assume an expatriate-only buyer pool; test demand against registered resale transactions in SIP for comparable units.

chengdu.friction_note: Check the current national eligibility documents and obtain a written reply from the local housing bureau for your household.
chengdu.pool_note: The risk is oversupply rather than price. In Tianfu and the outer districts resale can take a year and still fail.

nanjing.friction_note: Ask the district office to confirm which work or study records establish the required period for your application.
nanjing.pool_note: Treat any catchment premium as unverified until the education authority confirms eligibility and recent sales show it is reflected.

tianjin.friction_note: If buying in Binhai, verify the address-specific application process with that district rather than relying on a Tianjin-wide summary.
tianjin.pool_note: Compare registered sales and marketing times for the exact district and unit type; a low entry price does not prove exit liquidity.

qingdao.friction_note: Past local policies may not reflect current practice; ask the bureau which restrictions, if any, apply to this household today.
qingdao.pool_note: Use twelve months of verified rent and registered-sale data; seasonal asking prices are not evidence of year-round demand.

xiamen.friction_note: Confirm the accepted identity, residence and eligibility documents with the local office; a general statement is not approval.
xiamen.pool_note: Island and off-island submarkets differ; use registered transactions for the exact location rather than a citywide liquidity claim.

wuhan.friction_note: Ask the local bureau to confirm the required work or study period and the records it accepts for your application.
wuhan.pool_note: Test the resale pool with registered sales and time-on-market for the building; a lower price alone does not establish liquidity.
